snapshot.title: Desktop debug shortcut: skip active mission to debrief
snapshot.description: Add a desktop/editor-only Cmd+E shortcut that, once a mission has begun, completes the active mission's objectives in debug/test mode and opens the mission debrief. Must support missions that do and do not require mining by relying on mission objective structure rather than hard-coded mining assumptions.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Cmd+E on desktop/editor only skips an active begun mission to debrief
Debug completion satisfies that mission's objective requirements, including mining orders when present
Non-mining missions are handled without injecting fake mining requirements
No effect when no mission has begun or on non-desktop exports

changes.newValue:
1. Add a small debug mission completion helper around RocketsManager state, not the mining scene: resolve the latest active launched mission, target details, operation mode, and applicable objective payload.
2. Represent objectives generically in the helper output: mining objectives contribute collected/requested minerals and completion report; non-mining/no-order objectives return an empty cargo payload with objective_complete=true.
3. Add AppController Cmd+E handling gated to desktop/editor runtime only, ignored when no launched mission exists or when running web/mobile.
4. On shortcut, mark the active rocket/target as returned with the synthesized completion payload, remove it from active missions via return_home, clear preview target, record relevant tutorial actions, and navigate to mission_debrief_v2.
5. Add focused debug shortcut tests for active mining-order completion, no-active-mission no-op, and non-mining/no-order objective payload.
6. Run the targeted debug jump tests plus relevant debrief/mission tests.

snapshot.description: Introduce a first-class mission objective model for active missions, then use it to support a desktop/editor-only Cmd+E debug shortcut that completes the active mission according to its objective definition and opens the debrief. The model must support mining and non-mining missions without hard-coded assumptions.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Cmd+E on desktop/editor only skips an active begun mission to debrief
Debug completion satisfies that mission's objective requirements, including mining orders when present
Non-mining missions are handled without injecting fake mining requirements
No effect when no mission has begun or on non-desktop exports
Active missions persist a structured objective payload describing objective type and requirements
Mining-order objectives can be synthesized as complete for debug skip, including collected/requested minerals
Non-mining objectives can be synthesized as complete without fake mineral cargo
Cmd+E on desktop/editor only skips an active begun mission to debrief using the objective resolver
Cmd+E has no effect when no mission has begun or when running non-desktop/web export
Mission 1 debrief handoff recomputes after completion and routes to Control Station build step

snapshot.implementationPlan:
1. Define a small mission objective contract in a reusable utility (e.g. MissionObjectiveResolver): objective type, requirements, debug completion payload, and debrief metadata.
2. Wire launch creation to persist the objective payload onto each mission record. For current content this maps contractor/trip mining orders to mining_order objectives and supports no_cargo/progress-only objectives for non-mining cases.
3. Refactor AsteroidPreview return/debrief payload construction to read the mission objective where possible, keeping existing starter/trip contractor fields for backwards compatibility.
4. Add a RocketsManager/AppController debug completion path that finds the latest active mission, asks the objective resolver for a completed payload, sets returned_mission, removes the active mission, records tutorial progress, and changes to mission_debrief_v2.
5. Bind Cmd+E in AppController with desktop/editor gating and no-op behavior for web/mobile/no-active-mission.
6. Add tests for objective creation, mining-order debug completion, non-mining completion, shortcut gating/no-op behavior, and debrief compatibility.
7. Run targeted debug, mission flow, debrief, and structure tests.
